authorization: Kevin 27 September: accept explicit assumptions and imperfections, proceed toward useful insights. Reversible empirical development; no inferred formal gate approval or publication authority.
climate: Native CHELSA v2.1 1981-2010. Physical units; log1p precipitation amount BIO12 only, BIO15 stays coefficient of variation. Climate at representative native cell; no position-integrated likelihood.
basis: Training-availability standardized climate linear/squares. Shared cubic geographic spline and centered geographic-spline by climate terms. Four geographic knots at training weighted quantiles 0,1/3,2/3,1. Linear extrapolation. Same climate basis in S,L,C,CL; group +/-1 term added for L/CL. Conditional per-group centering and equal-group availability RMS scaling.
penalty_choice: Fixed before empirical scores; strongest value common in prior simulation selection is the working primary. Show both strengths, no score-driven promotion. No new nested tuning in this exploratory pass.
source_sensitivity: Discard S35 contributions for fitting, retain cells with any other eligible contributor. No changes to raw sources or accepted occurrence inputs. Score every fitted model on identical all-source held cells; also separately on the common non-S35 subset.
source_comparison_target: Emphasize common no-S35 held subset for comparing training-source sensitivity; primary all-source cohort describes the full development target. Never subtract scores with different test cohorts.
spatial: Existing native paired whole50km-block masks; saved full-pixel30km guard. Retain all nominal held cells. Additionally require exact WGS84 center distance minus BOTH effective source radii >=30km for every training/held occurrence pair. Never require whole uncertainty disk inside calibration boundary. Compare 1/5km unknown-radius scenarios without capping known radii.

quadrature.force: all allowed primary-cohort training presence cells; same reference across source cohorts

training_target: Equal retained native cells within group, equal groups; relative recorded-cell density conditional on available group geography
evaluation: Full native held area normalizer separately by biological group; equal held cells within group, equal groups/folds. Secondary equal occupied50km-block score. Every structural comparison uses identical held cells, domains and weights.
full_fits: Both ridge values, four structures, spline geography, all and no-S35 cohorts. Projection within assigned available geography; no occupancy probability or lineage physiology claim.
contrast: CL minus C primarily; L minus S and C minus S secondary. One linear-geography reference for all_1km only; no boundary search or matched-partition significance.
uncertainty: Three developmental geographic contrasts and declared sensitivities, not independent replicated tests or confidence intervals. All previously inspected empirical geography is exploratory.
